title: Welcome to the Underground
narrativeText: The arena smells like blood and cheap beer. The crowd doesn't want a match — they want carnage. Tonight, you give them what they came for.

choices.label: Start the Brawl
choices.text: No rules. No referees. Just you and them.

title: Backstage Ambush
narrativeText: {{RIVAL}} jumps you before the show even starts. Chairs fly. The crowd outside can hear the commotion through the walls.

choices.label: Fight Back Right Now
choices.text: No waiting. You return every shot with interest.

choices.label: Bide Your Time
choices.text: Let them think they got the better of you. Your moment will come.

title: The Stash
narrativeText: You find a storage closet packed with steel chairs, tables, and a bag of thumbtacks. Someone left it unlocked. Tonight's tools are ready.

choices.label: Use Everything Tonight
choices.text: Why save them? The crowd wants a Last Man Standing war.

choices.label: Save Them for the Right Moment
choices.text: Patience. The right opponent will come. You pocket the tacks.

title: The Booker's Demand
narrativeText: The underground booker has a simple message: make a statement or go home. {{RIVAL}} is waiting in the ring. The crowd is hungry.

choices.label: Make the Statement
choices.text: No more warm-ups. This is where legends are made.
